_doc: Single source of truth for all MQTT topics (C++: generated include/buddy/topics.hpp, Python: buddy_shared.topics).
Scheme buddy/<service>/<name>. Every service also has buddy/<service>/status = online|offline (retained, last will).
event: something happened or a state changed, published only by the owning service.
command: something should happen, consumed only by the owning service.
payload: the JSON object's fields, 'name: values' where useful, [optional]. planned: no service uses it yet.
web: false = a command the web panel may not publish (it has no login, D19: nothing that moves).
Extra hosts run system with BUDDY_SYSTEM_NAME set: service system-<name>, topics buddy/system-<name>/{state,status}, same payload as system_state.

topics.name: spotify_cmd
payload: action (watch: web panel heartbeat, polls state for 30 s)

topics.name: hue_cmd
payload: [device: room, zone or light as spoken]

topics.name: hue_state
payload: rooms: [{id, name, kind: home|room|zone, on, brightness, lights: [ids], scenes: [{id, name}]}]
lights: [{id, name, room, on, brightness, color, temperature, dimming, [mirek], [xy]}]

topics.name: messenger_cmd
payload: notify: text, [level: alert|info (default alert; info: no sound, and with the key of an earlier notice it edits that message)], [key]
ask: id (the asker's, unique), text, [options: [button labels]], [from: service], [ttl_s: 0 = never expires]; repeating an ask is safe: its current event comes back

topics.name: messenger_event
payload: [option: index into options, absent if Dev typed something else]

topics.name: messenger_state
payload: open: questions waiting for Dev (a count: /state is on the panel, texts never)

topics.name: table_debug
payload: hand: [{id, code}] (Buddy's hidden cards: not /state, so never on the panel)
ops: {scans, feeds, takes, deals, passes, recoveries}
